item.title: Polyethylene Microplastics And Liver Risk: Texas A&M links exposure to fatty liver signs; questions remain for human health
item.description: New research from Texas A&M University indicates that polyethylene microplastics may affect liver health negatively. The study observed significant signs of fatty liver disease linked to polyethylene exposure and a high-fat diet.
